1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# dec-write-lib.bats: the decision-ledger writer (.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh).
     4	#
     5	# Hermetic: every test copies the writer, its validator and compat-lib into a fresh temp project
     6	# (its own git repo and .run), so the host's run state, the live ledger and the operator's session
     7	# never leak in. The live grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml of this repository is never written.
     8	# Seams: the CLI (subcommands, exit codes) and the ledger file after each operation.
     9	# =============================================================================
    10	
    11	# An empty ledger carrying the tracked file's header only: fixtures never inherit live rows
    12	# (the live ledger is seeded in the main checkout).
    13	empty_ledger(){ { sed '/^schema_version:/,$d' "$1"; printf 'schema_version: 1\ndecisions: []\n'; } > "$2"; }
    14	
    15	setup() {
    16	  BATS_TEST_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
    17	  REPO="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    18	  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "jq not installed"
    19	  command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "yq not installed"
    20	  [[ "$(yq --version 2>&1)" == *mikefarah*"version v4."* ]] || skip "Mike Farah yq v4 not installed"
    21	  unset CLAUDE_SESSION_ID CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID LOA_UNATTENDED LOA_FLATLINE_MODE CI GITHUB_ACTIONS \
    22	        LOA_HOOK_CONTEXT LOA_DEC_NO_FLOCK LOA_DEC_LOCK_WAIT
    23	  T="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/proj"
    24	  mkdir -p "$T/.claude/scripts/lib" "$T/grimoires/loa"
    25	  cp "$REPO/.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh" "$T/.claude/scripts/lib/"
    26	  cp "$REPO/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh" "$REPO/.claude/scripts/validate-artifact.sh" "$T/.claude/scripts/"
    27	  [[ -f "$REPO/.claude/scripts/pii-filter.sh" ]] && cp "$REPO/.claude/scripts/pii-filter.sh" "$T/.claude/scripts/"
    28	  empty_ledger "$REPO/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml" "$T/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml"
    29	  git -C "$T" init -q
    30	  D="$T/.claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh"
    31	  L="$T/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml"
    32	  F="$T/fixture.yaml"
    33	  cp "$L" "$F"
    34	  ALT='{"option":"keep sequential","rejected_because":"one question per turn is slow"}'
    35	}
    36	
    37	# Same transformation as the writer's san1() (kf-write-lib.sh's), used to state expected values.
    38	DEC_ULB_RE="$(printf '\302[\200-\237]|\342\200[\250\251]')"
    39	san1(){ printf '%s' "${1-}" | LC_ALL=C tr -d '\000-\010\013\014\016-\037\177' | LC_ALL=C tr '\t\n\r' '   ' | LC_ALL=C sed -E "s/${DEC_ULB_RE}/ /g"' ; s/  +/ /g; s/^ //; s/ $//'; }
    40	
    41	# new_open FILE [extra args]  -> an open row
    42	new_open(){ local f="$1"; shift; bash "$D" new --file "$f" --summary "an open question" --phase discovery --category scope --recorded-by plan-and-analyze --source "prd.md#fr-1" --quiet "$@"; }
    43	# new_prop FILE [extra args]  -> a proposed row
    44	new_prop(){ local f="$1"; shift; bash "$D" new --file "$f" --summary "rounds is the thorough default" --phase discovery --category scope --recorded-by plan-and-analyze --source "prd.md#e (D1)" --status proposed --decision "pacing rounds" --rationale "brief recommendation" --alternative-json "$ALT" --cycle cycle-128 --quiet "$@"; }
    45	field(){ yq -o=json -I0 '.' "$1" | jq -r --arg id "$2" ".decisions[] | select(.id == \$id) | $3"; }
    46	ids(){ yq -o=json -I0 '.' "$1" | jq -r '[.decisions[].id] | join(",")'; }
    47	confirm_op(){ bash "$D" confirm --recorded-by decisions-command --evidence "cli:2026-10-13T12:00:00Z" --quiet "$@"; }
    48	lockpath(){ # target -> the writer's lock path
    49	  local abs; abs="$(cd "$(dirname "$1")" && pwd -P)/$(basename "$1")"
    50	  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
    51	  ( source "$REPO/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"; printf '%s/.run/.dec-write-%s.lock' "$(cd "$T" && pwd -P)" "$(printf '%s' "$abs" | sha256_portable | cut -c1-12)" )
    52	}
    53	# A PATH holding every command of the current PATH except $1 (the tool reads as absent).
    54	path_without(){
    55	  local tool="$1" d="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/pw-$1" p f b
    56	  mkdir -p "$d"
    57	  local IFS=:
    58	  for p in $PATH; do
    59	    [[ -d "$p" ]] || continue
    60	    for f in "$p"/*; do b="${f##*/}"; [[ "$b" == "$tool" || -e "$d/$b" ]] && continue; ln -s "$f" "$d/$b" 2>/dev/null || true; done
    61	  done
    62	  printf '%s' "$d"
    63	}
    64	
    65	# ---- ids, growth, verify-before-swap ------------------------------------------------
    66	
    67	@test "dec-write new: ids allocate max+1 and print DEC-%04d" {
    68	  run new_open "$F"; [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; [ "$output" = "DEC-0001" ]
    69	  run new_prop "$F"; [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; [ "$output" = "DEC-0002" ]
    70	  # a gap: max+1 from the highest id, never a reused or lower one
    71	  yq -i '.decisions[1].id = "DEC-0007" | .decisions[1].supersedes = null' "$F"
    72	  run new_open "$F"; [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; [ "$output" = "DEC-0008" ]
    73	  [ "$(ids "$F")" = "DEC-0001,DEC-0007,DEC-0008" ]
    74	}
    75	
    76	@test "dec-write: the ledger never shrinks and never drops an id across every operation" {
    77	  new_open "$F" >/dev/null; new_prop "$F" >/dev/null; new_open "$F" >/dev/null
    78	  local before; before="$(ids "$F")"
    79	  bash "$D" decide --file "$F" --id DEC-0001 --decision d --rationale r --alternative-json "$ALT" --evidence "interview turn 3" --recorded-by x --quiet
    80	  confirm_op --file "$F" --id DEC-0002
    81	  bash "$D" reject --file "$F" --id DEC-0003 --rationale "out of scope" --follow-up bd-abcd --recorded-by x --quiet
    82	  run bash "$D" supersede --file "$F" --id DEC-0002 --summary "a newer take" --phase discovery --category scope --recorded-by x --source s2 --decision d2 --rationale r2 --alternative-json "$ALT" --quiet
    83	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    84	  [ "$(ids "$F")" = "${before},DEC-0004" ]
    85	  [ "$(yq '.decisions | length' "$F")" -eq 4 ]
    86	}
    87	
    88	@test "dec-write: a failed write leaves the previous file byte-identical (validation refuses the candidate)" {
    89	  new_open "$F" >/dev/null
    90	  # plant a row the validator refuses (a URL in free text), as a hand edit would
    91	  yq -i '.decisions[0].summary = "see https://example.com"' "$F"
    92	  cp "$F" "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/before.yaml"
    93	  run new_open "$F"
    94	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
    95	  [[ "$output" == *"ledger untouched"* ]]
    96	  cmp "$F" "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/before.yaml"
    97	  # no temp file is left beside the target
    98	  [ -z "$(find "$T" -maxdepth 1 -name 'fixture.yaml.*')" ]
    99	}
   100	
   101	@test "dec-write: an unknown schema_version is refused before any write" {
   102	  yq -i '.schema_version = 2' "$F"; cp "$F" "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/before.yaml"
   103	  run new_open "$F"
   104	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
   105	  [[ "$output" == *"unknown schema_version"* ]]
   106	  cmp "$F" "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/before.yaml"
   107	}
   108	
   109	@test "dec-write: the header comment survives a write (yq keeps the head comment)" {
   110	  new_prop "$F" >/dev/null
   111	  grep -q '^# grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml: the decision ledger' "$F"
   112	  grep -q '^schema_version: 1' "$F"
   113	}
   114	
   115	@test "dec-write: ids come from the target file only; a populated live ledger does not shift a fresh --file fixture" {
   116	  # a throwaway "live" ledger with rows, at the project's live path
   117	  local i; for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do bash "$D" new --summary "live row $i" --phase discovery --category scope --recorded-by x --source s --quiet >/dev/null; done
   118	  [ "$(yq '.decisions | length' "$L")" -eq 5 ]
   119	  # and a populated ledger at another path
   120	  cp "$L" "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/other.yaml"
   121	  empty_ledger "$REPO/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml" "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/fresh.yaml"
   122	  run bash "$D" new --file "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/fresh.yaml" --summary s --phase discovery --category scope --recorded-by x --source s --quiet
   123	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; [ "$output" = "DEC-0001" ]
   124	  run bash "$D" list --file "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/fresh.yaml" --format json
   125	  [ "$(printf '%s' "$output" | jq 'length')" -eq 1 ]
   126	  # the live ledger continues from its own max
   127	  run bash "$D" new --summary "live row 6" --phase discovery --category scope --recorded-by x --source s --quiet
   128	  [ "$output" = "DEC-0006" ]

content.text:
Review written to `/workspace/review.md`. Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED.

I rebuilt the PR's head tree in a scratch project with stubs for the untouched libraries and ran the new bats suites. The writer, round checker, surface hook, validator and command-allowlist suites pass on their own terms. Two correctness defects and one packaging gap came out of reading and probing the code directly:

- **Operator confirm recorded as an agent decision.** The writer lets `/decisions confirm` proceed when the only unattended signal is the PRD Status line, but then drops the operator's answer reference. The row lands `decided_by: agent` with a null reference while the transition says the operator made it. Reproduced against the head writer. This is the attribution the whole ledger exists to capture.
- **A rejected replacement blocks the old row forever.** After the operator rejects an agent-proposed supersede, the decided row still points at the rejected row, so any later agent supersede is refused as "already proposed". Reproduced. Neither the writer nor the validator allow clearing the pointer.
- **The tracked ledger is not in the change.** The gitignore negation, the gitignore-state check, the writer's "restore the tracked ledger" error, and every new suite's setup assume `grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml` exists in the repo, yet the PR does not add it. Unless it already lives tracked in the base tree, fresh checkouts cannot write the live ledger and the suites fail at setup.

Two low-severity notes round it out: the example config pins `pacing: rounds` against its own comment about mode-dependent defaults, and the grimoire index preamble still names a removed family while omitting the new one.

One test failure I did not report: the surface hook's hostile-row test expects "ignore previous instructions" to be stripped. The hook itself never does that, so it depends on the real L6 sanitizer, which I could not inspect. Worth a glance from someone with the full tree.

The scratch directories have been removed and the workspace holds only `pr/` and `review.md`.
